description: Create, update or destroy a reverse_proxy exception entry in SOPHOS UTM.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: A dictionary of additional headers to be sent to POST and PUT requests. Is needed for some modules. Default: {}

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the object that identifies the entry.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: The operand to be used with the entries of the path parameter. Choices: "AND" ← (default) "OR"

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The paths the exception in the reverse proxy is defined for. Default: []

parameters.name: skip_custom_threats_filters
parameters.description: A list of threats to be skipped. Default: []

parameters.name: skip_threats_filter_categories
parameters.description: Define which categories of threats are skipped. Default: []

parameters.name: skipav
parameters.description: Skip the Antivirus Scanning. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skipbadclients
parameters.description: Block clients with bad reputation. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skipcookie
parameters.description: Skip the Cookie Signing check. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skipform
parameters.description: Enable form hardening. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skipform_missingtoken
parameters.description: Enable form hardening with missing tokens. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skiphtmlrewrite
parameters.description: Protection against SQL. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skiptft
parameters.description: Enable true file type control. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: skipurl
parameters.description: Enable static URL hardening. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Define which categories of threats are skipped. Default: []

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The desired state of the object. present creates or updates an object. absent deletes an object if present. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of the exception rule set. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_host
parameters.description: The REST Endpoint of the Sophos UTM.

parameters.name: utm_port
parameters.description: The port of the REST interface. Default: 4444

parameters.name: utm_protocol
parameters.description: The protocol of the REST Endpoint. Choices: "http" "https" ← (default)

parameters.name: utm_token
parameters.description: The token used to identify at the REST-API. See https://www.sophos.com/en-us/medialibrary/PDFs/documentation/UTMonAWS/Sophos-UTM-RESTful-API.pdf?la=en, Chapter 2.4.2.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether the REST interface’s SSL certificate should be verified or not. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create UTM proxy_exception
  community.general.utm_proxy_exception:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestExceptionEntry
    backend: REF_OBJECT_STRING
    state: present

- name: Remove UTM proxy_exception
  community.general.utm_proxy_exception:
    utm_host: sophos.host.name
    utm_token: abcdefghijklmno1234
    name: TestExceptionEntry
    state: absent

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: The utm object that was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: _locked
return_values.description: Whether or not the object is currently locked. Returned: success

return_values.name: _ref
return_values.description: The reference name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: _type
return_values.description: The type of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: comment
return_values.description: The optional comment string. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the object. Returned: success

return_values.name: op
return_values.description: The operand to be used with the entries of the path parameter. Returned: success

return_values.name: path
return_values.description: The paths the exception in the reverse proxy is defined for. Returned: success

return_values.name: skip_custom_threats_filters
return_values.description: A list of threats to be skipped. Returned: success

return_values.name: skip_threats_filter_categories
return_values.description: Define which categories of threats are skipped. Returned: success

return_values.name: skipav
return_values.description: Skip the Antivirus Scanning. Returned: success

return_values.name: skipbadclients
return_values.description: Block clients with bad reputation. Returned: success

return_values.name: skipcookie
return_values.description: Skip the Cookie Signing check. Returned: success

return_values.name: skipform_missingtoken
return_values.description: Enable form hardening with missing tokens. Returned: success

return_values.name: skiptft
return_values.description: Enable true file type control. Returned: success

return_values.name: skipurl
return_values.description: Enable static URL hardening. Returned: success
